The implementation is complete, tested, committed, and pushed. Here's a summary of the solution:

## Summary

**Issue fixed:** Go-side invocation of script-defined functions/closures was broken (`CompiledFunction` reported `CanCall() == true` but had no `Call` implementation), and moving callables between compiled instances leaked the original runtime.

### Changes

**`callable.go` (new):**
- `CompiledFunction.Call(args...)` — runs a function as the VM root frame with the owning instance's constants, globals, imports, closure captures, variadic handling, recursion, tail calls, and identical `Runtime Error: ...\n\tat file:line:col` formatting.
- Runtime binding/transfer engine:
  - `bindValue`/`bindDeep` — recursively binds callables found in arrays/maps/errors returned by calls or handed to Go callbacks; same-instance functions stay live, foreign ones are snapshotted.
  - `prepareGlobal`/`adoptDeep` — transfers values assigned via `Compiled.Set` / `Script.Add`, snapshotting captured locals at transfer time and recursively handling every callable inside composites.
  - `callRuntime` with `owner`/derived runtimes: transferred functions keep their original constants/file set but resolve globals **by name against the destination instance**, with a shared per-instance shadow table for names the destination doesn't define.
  - Memo/pointer maps preserve aliasing between closures and recursion/self-references through transfers and clones.

**`vm.go`:** per-frame runtime (`frame.rt`), per-frame constants (so transferred functions execute their own bytecode universe), name-based global resolution/assignment, `runCallable` mirroring `OpCall` frame setup, callback-argument binding, and cycle-safe error wrapping.

**`script.go`:** per-instance constants slice bound to the instance runtime; `Run` uses it; `Clone` deep-copies constants/globals with shared memo (preserving aliasing and cycles) and rebinds callables to the clone; `Get`/`GetAll`/`Set` bind callables appropriately.

**`objects.go`:** `CompiledFunction` gained an unexported runtime binding; `Copy` now also carries `SourceMap`.

**Tests/docs:** `callable_test.go` covers Go calls on globals, nested arrays/maps, module exports, callback args, variadics, recursion (including tail-call), return format, transfer snapshot/isolation, destination-globals resolution, shadow sharing, nested recursive transfer, clone isolation with module alias preservation, and cyclic values. Documentation updated in `docs/interoperability.md` and `docs/objects.md`.

All unit tests, race tests, and `go vet` pass. Branch `feature/callable-instance-isolation` is committed and pushed to origin (rebased on the existing remote WIP commits).
